questions.question: Why were the Israelites forbidden to eat blood?
options: Because the life of the flesh is in the blood
Because it spoils quickly in the heat
Because it is wasteful to pour it out
Because it tastes bitter to the tongue
questions.answer: Because the life of the flesh is in the blood

questions.question: Where were the Israelites to bring their sacrifices?
options: To the entrance of the tent of meeting
To any high place they happened to choose
To the private altars of each household
To the tops of the surrounding mountains
questions.answer: To the entrance of the tent of meeting

questions.question: God said that the blood makes atonement for the life (soul).
"For the _____ of the flesh is in the blood."
It is the _____ that makes atonement by reason of the life.
